main_text.p: Sine Adverbio, nomen caussæ, instrumenti, vel similis circunstantiæ, nomini aut verbo frequenter apponitur, ut, שִׂמְחִי ṙʻ רַעְתִּי semeche raathi, læti malo meo. חֲלָלִי chalele chereb, vulnerati gladio.
Quomodo notatur soph pasuk, id est, finis versus seu periodi?
Signatur virgula Metheg sub ultima periodi voce posita, sequentibus duobus punctis intra lineam subalternatim collocatis, ut : יֵשֵׁב jaschab, sedit.
Quomodo notatur Athnach, id est, Colon?
Hoc signo ˆ sub litera posito, ut עָמַד amád, stetit.
Quomodo notatur Revia, id est, Comma?
Puncto supra mediam literam posito, הָאִישׁ häisch, ille vir. Differt à puncto vo-r

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed approximately from the scan; the vowel points and accents are not fully legible at this resolution, so the Hebrew forms may contain errors. The final line runs over the page break: "vo-" continues on the next page with "r" shown as the catchword/line-end. The Hebrew in the first example line (שְׁמָחִי / רָעָתִי / חָרֵב) and the word at the line end "חָרֶב" are approximate. Hyphen at line end "vo-" kept as printed.
